title: hindsight-ext-acl access file
description: Identities, their keys and their bank access for the hindsight-ext-acl Hindsight extension. Cross-field rules (unique keys, unique prefixes, identity type must be declared, 'root' reserved) are checked by `hindsight-acl check`.

types.description: Identity types and their own-space prefix. Optional; when omitted: user -> usr, agent -> agn. When present it replaces the defaults.

prefix.description: Own space is '<prefix>-<id>-*'. Omit for a type with no own space.

identities.description: One entry per key holder: a person, or one agent runtime instance (an OpenClaw gateway, an OpenCode install).

type.description: A type declared under 'types' (default: user or agent).

admin.description: Full access to every bank over API and MCP.

runtime.description: Optional. Changes the write tag to '<type>:<runtime>:<id>'.

key_sha256.description: sha256 hex of the identity's key (hindsight-acl keygen). Never the key itself.

grants.description: Access to banks outside the identity's own space. Highest matching level wins.

banks.description: Bank ids or shell-style glob patterns (hsm-infra, sanomed-*).

access.description: r = read; tag = read + write only with the identity's tag; rw = read + write + manage.
